lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest density observed in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of spots to create a subtle grid-like appearance along the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running along the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance increase on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs located within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered towards the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two small, yellow-pigmented pilot fish (Naucrates ductor) characterized by vertical black bands, located ventral to the primary lateral ridge on the mid-flank.
